description: Trigger and behavior evals for the collaborative book-writing skill with co-design, chapter drafting, and story bible support.

tests.prompt: Write a goblin story for my kids
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on new book request
Starts with co-design phase (Phase 1) to define story premise, characters, and arc
Does not skip to drafting; co-design is mandatory first step

tests.prompt: Draft the next chapter of my book
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on chapter draft request
Enters Phase 2 drafting loop with checkpoint reviews
References the story bible and prior chapters for consistency

tests.prompt: Turn these notes into a book
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on new book from existing material
Starts with co-design phase to structure notes into a coherent narrative
Establishes story bible from the material
Skill triggers on existing project resume
Loads story bible and prior work state
Resumes from where the project left off (co-design or draft phase)

tests.prompt: Write a blog post about X
grading_criteria: Routes to blog skill, not storycraft

tests.prompt: Do a research study on Y and open a PR
grading_criteria: Routes to scientific-study skill, not storycraft
